title: Two Sum II Input Array Is Sorted
summary: Pick two positions in a sorted list whose entries add to the target.

contractDetails.constraints: The array has 2–30,000 entries sorted in nondecreasing order. Its values and the target are in [−1,000, 1,000]. Exactly one pair of distinct positions works.

statement: Pick two positions in a sorted list whose entries add to the target. Return the two one-based indices in increasing order. Use constant extra space.

examples.explanation: The two twos are separate entries.
The two end values add to 6.

constraints: The array has 2–30,000 entries sorted in nondecreasing order. Its values and the target are in [−1,000, 1,000]. Exactly one pair of distinct positions works.
hints: Conceptual: The ends give you the smallest and largest entries still available.
Directional: When the sum is too small, the left entry cannot work with any remaining partner.
Implementation: Start at the ends. Move left inward for a low sum and right inward for a high sum. Convert both indices to one-based on a match.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space. Every failed comparison discards one candidate position.
